obraz: The door swollen by rain opens at the third push of your shoulder.
proc: A stuck door gives way to bodily force from the shoulder.
Resistance gives way to bodily force.

obraz: After months of practice, you answer in the new language without translating first.
proc: Long earlier practice shows as a result at its own time.
Long earlier work shows as an unhurried result.

obraz: The potato forgotten in the cupboard has put out white shoots.
proc: Unseen and untouched, something completed itself in the dark and sprouted.
Shut away unseen, something grew by itself from within.

obraz: The rowan feeds the thrush, and the thrush carries its seed over the hill.
proc: Each side gives the other something, an uncounted exchange.
A two-way exchange in which each side gives and receives.

obraz: You turn down the praise and say whose work it was.
proc: You give up credit knowingly to keep to what is right.
Keeping to the truth at one's own cost, giving credit away.

obraz: The reply is written in a single breath, and your thumb stops above the send button.
proc: A stop just before the rushed move is made.
A rushed move is stopped just before it is made.

obraz: The coins dropped in the jar each evening are, one day, the fare.
proc: Small acts done long before add up to a result in time.
Small acts done long before ripen into a result.

obraz: The recipe card is in another hand, with one change added in yours.
proc: A handed-down thing carried on with one own change.
Something handed down and carried on with one's own choice added.

obraz: Halfway through the dishes a song comes on, and you both join in.
proc: Shared joy arrives in the middle of a task.
Shared joy in the middle of a task.

obraz: The child struggles with the zip, and you wait while they try again.
proc: A small one is given room to try rather than being forced.
Fragile growing ability is given room rather than forced.

obraz: The cold of the river at your ankles stops you before the current does.
proc: A sharp sensation stops the step before the danger is reached.
A sharp sensation halts the step before the danger does.

obraz: The footbridge sways under the crowd and is still again when they have crossed.
proc: It bends under strain and does not break.
The bridge bends under strain and returns unbroken.

obraz: The table has moved through three homes and still stands in the kitchen.
proc: A thing carried from home to home and kept.
A thing carried on from home to home.

obraz: Dinner is burnt, and the table laughs over bread and cheese.
proc: Shared laughter in the middle of a failed dinner.
Shared lightness in the middle of a failed plan.

obraz: The seedling droops for a week in its new pot, then puts out one leaf.
proc: Fragile new growth begins after being given time and room.
Fragile new growth takes hold when given time and room.

obraz: Your foot is already off the kerb when the horn sounds.
proc: A sharp signal halts a step already begun at the edge.
A sharp stop at the threshold just as the move is made.

obraz: The tall grass lies flat in the wind and is standing again by evening.
proc: Grass bends flat under the wind and stands again unbroken.
It bends under force and does not break.

obraz: The stream runs in the bed the old river cut.
proc: The present follows the course inherited from what came before.
The new follows the course handed down by the old.

obraz: On the first warm day every door on the street stands open.
proc: A shared lightening across the whole street at once.
A shared lightening across the whole street.

obraz: The eider plucks her own down to line the nest.
proc: Care for new life, giving of herself to shelter it.
Care preparing room for fragile new life, at her own cost.

obraz: One person says the name no one has said all evening, and the table goes quiet.
proc: A spoken name arrives and changes the room.
A spoken name arrives and changes the room.

obraz: The runner slows to a walk on the hill and does not stop.
proc: Endures the strain by yielding pace without giving up.
Enduring the strain by yielding without breaking off.

obraz: You read the same message again in the morning, and it says something else.
proc: After the turn from night to morning the same thing reads differently.
After the turn of night to morning the same thing reads differently.

obraz: The flight is cancelled at the gate, and the queue turns round as one.
proc: An outside force breaks the plan for everyone at once.
The plan is broken from outside and everyone must turn.

obraz: Two people walk side by side, and neither could say who set the pace.
proc: Two move in a common rhythm neither imposed.
Two share a rhythm that neither imposed.

obraz: Said aloud, the plan sounds different from the one in your head.
proc: Speaking the thing aloud changes what it means.
Speaking aloud changes what the thing means.

obraz: A parcel sits on the step, taped shut, with no sender's name.
proc: A closed container whose content exists but is not yet known.
A closed vessel whose content exists but is not yet known.

obraz: You turn the map on your phone, and the street falls into place.
proc: Things literally fall into place and one sees where one stands.
A turn after which the same view suddenly makes sense.

obraz: A power cut ends the video call and takes the unsaved slide with it.
proc: An uninvited outside force cuts things off and shows what is lost.
An outside force breaks in and takes the work with it.

obraz: Two people carry a long mirror through the doorway, one pausing as the other turns.
proc: Two progress only by timing their moves to each other.
Two move one load by adjusting to each other's rhythm.

obraz: The raven calls once from the roof, and everyone at the door looks up.
proc: A single sound arrives and turns everyone attention.
A single sound arrives and turns everyone's attention.

obraz: An unnamed voice memo sits in your phone, three minutes long.
proc: Something exists with content not yet heard or named.
Content exists but is closed and not yet known; only the name is missing.

obraz: The tide has turned, and the same boats now point the other way.
proc: A turn after which the same things face the opposite way.
A turning after which the same things face the opposite way.

obraz: One minute of hail, and the tulips are lying on the path.
proc: Literal hail from outside flattens what stood.
An uninvited outside force flattens what stood.

obraz: Two swans cross the lake, and the gap between them never changes.
proc: Two move together keeping a constant common pace.
Two move together in a steady shared rhythm.

obraz: The path across the grass is on no plan; it is where everyone actually walks.
proc: A road made simply by people walking it.
A road made by walking it.

obraz: Something has crossed the snow in the night, and the tracks end at the stream.
proc: A hidden mover whose trail disappears into water.
The trace vanishes into water; what passed stays hidden.

obraz: A new document is open, and the cursor blinks on the first line.
proc: An empty page where nothing has been written yet.
An open empty space where nothing is written yet.

obraz: The phone is at two per cent, and you send the one message that matters.
proc: Scarcity forces the choice of what is truly needed.
Scarcity forces the choice of what is truly needed.

obraz: You hear your own phrase come out of a friend's mouth and learn how it sounds.
proc: You learn about yourself through another person echoing you.
One learns about oneself through another's echo.

obraz: On the long drive you miss your turning because the road was so easy to follow.
proc: The rhythm of the road carries you past where you meant to go.
The road carries on but no longer leads where one meant to go.

obraz: The door opens on its chain, just far enough to see who is knocking.
proc: A guarded opening that looks out without letting in.
Guarded openness: open enough to see, not to let in.

obraz: One wall in the new flat is still bare, without a single nail hole.
proc: An unmarked surface with nothing yet placed on it.
An untouched surface with no mark yet.

obraz: One seat is left on the last bus, and two of you are still on the pavement.
proc: Not enough for both; constraint presses a decision.
There is not enough for both; constraint presses.

obraz: A friend copies the way you tap your foot, and you had never noticed it.
proc: You see an unnoticed trait of your own mirrored by a friend.
One sees oneself through another person's mirroring.

obraz: After the first hour of walking your feet stop asking how far it is.
proc: A rhythm found only by walking on.
A rhythm found only by walking.

obraz: The phone is silenced for the night, with three numbers allowed to ring through.
proc: A guard that shuts out most but lets a chosen few through.
A guard that shuts out most but lets a chosen few through.

obraz: Fresh snow lies on the field, and nothing has crossed it yet.
proc: An untouched surface with no mark on it yet.
An unmarked surface where nothing is written yet.

obraz: The birch on the lava field grows no taller than the rock that shelters it.
proc: The rock stands between the tree and the threat, and constraint limits growth.
Something stands between the threat and what it shelters; growth is bounded by it.

obraz: In the dark window of the train your own face sits among the other passengers.
proc: Your own face seen among other people in a reflection.
One's own face seen among others in a mirror.

obraz: The phone light finds the dropped key, and beside it a long-lost earring.
proc: A small light reveals something that was there all along.
A small light reveals something that was there all along.

obraz: The geese feed with one head always raised.
proc: One always keeps watch while the others feed.
One always keeps watch while the others feed.

obraz: The candle kept for a special evening has never been lit.
proc: A valued thing kept unused, never put to its purpose.
Value held back and never used does nothing.

obraz: The waterfall has become a wall of ice, its last streams held against the rock.
proc: Moving water stopped and held as it is.
Flowing water has stopped and is held in place.

obraz: Your foot finds the brake as the car ahead drifts, before you know why.
proc: The body senses and acts before the reason can be explained.
The body senses the danger before it can be explained.

obraz: The new bulb in the hallway shows a crack that was always in the ceiling.
proc: A light shows a flaw that was always there.
Light reveals what was there all along.

obraz: The cloud lifts, and you see how far up the slope you already are.
proc: Clearing lets you see where you stand.
Light clears and one sees where one stands.

obraz: The battery you never use is flat on the day you need it.
proc: What was left standing unused has lost its strength.
What is left unused loses its strength.

obraz: A chain of bubbles rises through the dark water, then stops beneath the clear ice.
proc: Rising movement is halted and held under ice, visible in stillness.
Rising movement is halted and held under ice, visible.

obraz: You turn back at the door, sure something is left behind, before you know what.
proc: Something is sensed before it can be named.
Something is sensed before it can be explained.

obraz: One match in the cave shows the wall an arm's length away and no further.
proc: A small flame reveals only what lies close.
A small flame reveals only what is near.

obraz: The low sun comes in under the cloud, and every stone on the moor has a shadow.
proc: The sun simply shines and everything shows its place.
The sun's light makes every thing stand out where it is.

obraz: The pool cut off from the river clouds over while the river runs clear.
proc: What stops flowing spoils while what moves stays good.
What stands still spoils while what moves stays good.

obraz: A drop has frozen at the tip of an icicle, just before it falls.
proc: A moving drop stopped and held just before falling.
A moving drop is frozen and held as it is.

obraz: The swell lifts the boat before any wave can be seen.
proc: A movement under the surface is felt before it is seen.
A hidden movement under the surface is felt before it is seen.

obraz: You bring a dish to the shared dinner and leave with a plate of someone else's cooking.
proc: Giving and receiving between people, uncounted.
Something given and something received, uncounted exchange.

obraz: The sun comes round to the window, and every fingerprint on the glass shows.
proc: Sunlight shows everything, even more than is comfortable.
Sunlight simply shines and shows everything.

obraz: The lid holds, and holds, and gives under your grip.
proc: Resistance gives way to bodily grip strength.
Resistance gives way to bodily force.

obraz: The lift stops between floors, and the building goes on humming around it.
proc: Movement stops and is held while all around goes on.
Movement has stopped and is held while all else goes on.

obraz: The dough rests under a tea towel, and by morning it has doubled.
proc: Covered and left alone, it completes itself within.
Covered and left alone, it completes itself within.

obraz: The borrowed book comes back with a bar of chocolate on top.
proc: A loan returned with an uncounted gift on top.
A thing passes between two hands and returns with a gift.

obraz: Everyone agreed in the corridor; on the form there is one name, and it is yours.
proc: You alone put your name to it and carry the cost.
One alone stands behind the position in writing and bears it.

obraz: The salmon throws itself at the falls again.
proc: Raw bodily force thrown against resistance, repeatedly.
Raw bodily force thrown against resistance, repeatedly.

obraz: The tree planted as a sapling beside the bench now shades the place where you sit.
proc: What was planted long ago now yields its result.
What was planted long ago now gives its result.

obraz: The broken bone knits under the cast, and nothing can be seen of it.
proc: Healing completes inside, closed off and invisible.
Completion happens inside while nothing shows outside.

obraz: Someone has remembered how you take your coffee.
proc: A small uncounted attention given from one person to another.
A small uncounted gift of attention from one to another.

obraz: You tell the referee the ball was out, and your own team loses the point.
proc: Keeping to the truth and knowingly paying the price.
Honesty kept knowingly at a price.
